name: workspace-search-proof
description: Isolated, destroyable Project Think workspace-search proof — seeds many files via DO RPC, forces Think to use list/find/grep/read tools, and verifies tool invocation via a durable evidence log.

scripts.deploy:personal: STAGE=personal bash scripts/personal-env.sh npx alchemy deploy --stage personal
scripts.destroy:personal: STAGE=personal bash scripts/personal-env.sh npx alchemy destroy --stage personal
